source.subject: perf: promote C64 Prefill down schedule

measured_binary.note: Measured from the promotion worktree. The committed source differs only by documentation and source comments added after the formal runs. A complete post-commit rebuild and Release suite also passed.

production_schedule.gate_up: main/auxiliary branch overlap retained; each C64 branch contains two ordered C32 projections
production_schedule.causal_state_and_rope: ordered subtiles of at most M16
production_schedule.partial_wide_controller: a candidate of 33..63 tokens is emitted as C32 followed by a recomputed <=31-token tail

formal_protocol.prompt_construction: P(N) uses N-12 space-separated copies of ASCII hello and the pinned non-thinking single-user chat template
formal_protocol.comparison: arithmetic mean of mirrored process medians

formal_results.candidate_schedule: one C32 tile; exact-M64 is not selected
formal_results.gate: pass: mirrored P33 has no regression

formal_results.candidate_schedule: one C64 tile followed by one C32 tile
formal_results.gate: pass: mixed exact/tail coverage improves without changing output

correctness.direct_c64_fixed_fixture: pass: 19 prompt IDs, 26 generated IDs, exact text, im_end, and 44 steps
correctness.m64_micro_bitwise_gate: 0/327680 BF16 mismatches for checkpoint-like and same-bank scale distributions

memory.assessment: The C2 warning was retained but did not reproduce in C1 or C3 and did not affect correctness or latency admission.

nsight_p513_route_closure.protocol: one no-warmup measured P513/max1 process per C32/C64 policy with CUDA+NVTX tracing; diagnostic topology evidence, not the formal latency distribution
nsight_p513_route_closure.gate_up_note: C64 retains branch overlap and the same instance count. Its cumulative per-kernel duration increases under overlap, while the controlling NVTX critical span improves 5.775% and idle remains below 0.04%.

tests.projection_backend_dispatch: pass including M33/M63/M64, one-node exact down, two-M32 non-down, near-miss fallback, full-span alias, and M65 fail-before-enqueue
tests.request_state_plan: pass including exact C64 workspace and maximum arena
tests.reference_benchmark_control: pass including shared partial-wide timing cardinality

decision.result: promote exact C64 NVFP4 down and the C64 request/runner boundary
decision.why: Every correctness and formal Prefix gate passes. Exact-C64 workloads reach 1.062855x-1.065650x Prefix speedup, the mixed P97 schedule reaches 1.042762x, P33 is neutral, and Nsight confirms the intended 1024-to-512 down-launch transition.
decision.decode_policy: The non-MTP Decode anchor remains frozen at 105.870500 ms/token and 9.445501816 token/s. Decode Graph screens remain explicitly pinned to P19/C32.
decision.next_priority: Re-profile the promoted C64 path, then run a bounded M64 gate/up pair experiment; if overlap fails its pair-level gate, move directly to M64 FP8 projections. FlashInfer attention remains a later isolated backend experiment because attention was only 5.763 percent of the prior P513 kernel union.

limitations: The formal latency result is batch-one, one checkpoint, fixed clocks, max1, and mirrored process medians; it is not a serving-throughput or tail-latency claim.
The independent vLLM/FlashInfer 2k-8k token/s result supplied by the user is not directly comparable until model, precision, prompt, token accounting, concurrency, and hardware are matched.
C64 increases request workspace by 5,445,632 bytes. It does not introduce double/triple buffering, continuous batching, MTP, a server, or Prefill/Decode overlap.
One formal C64 process reported a 239,554,560-byte free-memory drop; two other C64 processes did not reproduce it, including an independent rerun with only 131,072 bytes maximum observed drop.
